quotes.text: f.38 ¿Cuántas horas trabajó en la semana de referencia en este trabajo? Dígame día por día.
… quien realiza los quehaceres del hogar?

assessments.reasoning: The survey instrument records hours spent on paid work (e.g., question f.38), but does not contain questions recording time allocated across other daily activities such as unpaid domestic or care work, leisure, or self-care. Following the specific indicator instruction ('If the instrument only records hours of paid work, with no time recorded for any other daily activity, all four statements are false'), all four elements are evaluated as false.
